name: MMP Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1983, MMP Industries Ltd manufactures and sells aluminium  powder products[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
MMPIL manufactures aluminum powders, aluminum foils, and aluminum conductors/cables. It is associated with  Toyo Aluminium K.K. Japan, which helps provide technological support to the company.

cons: Company has a low return on equity of 11.2% over last 3 years.
Dividend payout has been low at 11.2% of profits over last 3 years
Debtor days have increased from 37.8 to 47.2 days.
